How often is there no run in the first inning? In the 2026 MLB regular season, 49.4% of 2,429 games stayed scoreless through the first (NRFI). The Marlins led the league at 60% of their games; the Rockies were last at 38%. The tables below come from the official inning-by-inning line scores and cover the regular season through September 27, 2026. Our [NRFI and YRFI picks](../mlb/nrfi-yrfi-picks.qmd) start from a 20,000-simulation model of each game rather than from these rates, but the rates are the context every bettor should know.

## NRFI rate by team, 2026

NRFI is a game with no run by either team in the first inning. *Scored in 1st* and *Allowed in 1st* are the team's own halves, which is what drives the NRFI rate from each side.

::: {.faq-item}
### What percentage of MLB games are NRFI?

In the 2026 regular season, 49.4% of games had no run in the first inning. The rate moves a few points from season to season and with the weather, and it varies a lot by starting pitcher.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which team has the best NRFI record in 2026?

The Miami Marlins, with no first-inning run in 97 of 162 games (60%). The Colorado Rockies had the lowest rate at 38%.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which starting pitcher has the best first-inning record?

Andrew Alvarez, who allowed no first-inning run in 16 of 17 starts (94%) in 2026. The list above shows every starter with 15 or more starts.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Does a high team NRFI rate make NRFI a good bet?

Only if the price does not already reflect it. Books price NRFI from the same starters, lineups and parks, so a team's record is the starting point, not the edge. Our model simulates every game 20,000 times with that day's starters, lineups and weather and compares the result to the posted price; see [MLB NRFI and YRFI picks](../mlb/nrfi-yrfi-picks.qmd) and the [NRFI guide](../guides/what-is-nrfi-yrfi.qmd).
:::
